cards.title: Pick an integration

cards.title: Connect your account

cards.title: Watch data flow
cards.body: From then on, every submission moves to your tools the moment it arrives.

faqList.header: What do form integrations actually do?
faqList.body: They connect your forms to the software you already use — CRMs, spreadsheets, email tools, payment gateways. When someone submits a form, the data is sent to your connected tools automatically, so there's no manual export or copy-paste.

faqList.header: Do I need to know how to code?
faqList.body: No. Every native integration is set up in a few clicks from your form's Automate tab — sign in, authorize, done. Webhooks and the API are there if your team wants something custom.
Core integrations like Google Sheets, Slack, and webhooks are available on the Free plan. A few advanced integrations are part of paid plans — each integration page lists which plan it needs.

faqList.header: What happens if an integration stops working?
faqList.body: Your submissions are always stored safely in Formester first, so nothing is lost. Reconnect the integration from the Automate tab; if the issue continues, our support team is available 24/7.
